items.stem: Why can a rocket produce thrust in the vacuum of space?

options.text: It expels mass, and conservation of momentum pushes it the other way
options.rationale: Correct: thrust comes from expelling mass, not pushing on air.

options.text: It pushes against the surrounding air
options.rationale: There is no air in vacuum; thrust is from expelled mass.

options.text: It uses wings to generate lift
options.rationale: Wings need air; rockets work by momentum exchange.

options.text: It is pulled forward by gravity
options.rationale: Gravity does not provide forward thrust here.

items.explanation: Correct: thrust comes from expelling mass, not pushing on air.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO statements about specific impulse and the rocket equation are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Higher specific impulse means more delta-v for the same propellant
options.rationale: Correct: specific impulse measures propulsion efficiency.

options.text: A higher mass ratio increases achievable delta-v
options.rationale: Correct: carrying relatively more propellant raises delta-v.

options.text: Delta-v is independent of exhaust velocity
options.rationale: Delta-v depends directly on exhaust velocity.

options.text: Specific impulse has no effect on performance

items.explanation: Correct: specific impulse measures propulsion efficiency.

items.stem: Why do launch vehicles often use multiple stages?

options.text: Dropping empty stages sheds dead mass, improving overall performance
options.rationale: Correct: staging discards spent structure to boost efficiency.

options.text: Because more stages always cost less money
options.rationale: Staging adds complexity and cost; the benefit is performance.

options.text: Because single stages cannot carry fuel
options.rationale: Single stages carry fuel; staging improves mass efficiency.

options.text: Because stages make the rocket lighter at liftoff
options.rationale: Liftoff mass is not reduced by staging; dead mass is shed in flight.

items.explanation: Correct: staging discards spent structure to boost efficiency.
